display_name: Read a session's cached context-window occupancy
description: maintenance-verbs M1 (shape (a)). Reads back the cached snapshot report_context_status last wrote for one agent_instance_id: model, current_tokens, ceiling, the derived fraction of ceiling, a per-prompt carriage-cost estimate (~10% of current_tokens, the operator's own cached-context-cost arithmetic), whether rotation is due (fraction >= rotation_thresholds.ROTATION_THRESHOLD_FRACTION), and when it was measured. resolved=false (never a raised error) is the expected, stable shape when no report has landed yet for that session — a fresh session pre-first-tick, or (until its own seat-wiring design note is acted on) a host=operator seat. This handler is a trivial state read; it never resolves a transcript path or touches a file itself.
embedding_description: Read a session's current context-window usage as a fraction of its model's ceiling, plus a rotation-due flag and a per-prompt carriage-cost estimate — the rotation-economics gauge, distinct from budget_report (lifetime spend per budget_line, excludes host=operator, wrong instrument for this) and from session_status (the lifecycle ledger row, unrelated to context occupancy).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: resolved, resolution_error, agent_instance_id, claude_session_id, model, current_tokens, ceiling, fraction, per_prompt_carriage_estimate_tokens, rotation_due, measured_at.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with resolved — if false, report resolution_error verbatim and stop; never estimate a number in its place. If resolved and rotation_due is true, say so plainly; the operator's checkpoint-and-stop tripwire (~60% of ceiling) is stricter than this verb's own rotation_due flag (0.5), so a caller applying the tripwire should compare fraction directly, not rely on rotation_due alone.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A single filtered read on agent_instance_id against the session_context_status cache table.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: agent_instance_id was empty. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. Absence of a cached row is NOT an error — it returns resolved=false in a normal successful result, never a raised failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For missing_argument, supply the target session's own agent_instance_id (ledger id for a worker, from list_sessions/session_status; a worker/seat's own env-native AGENT_INSTANCE_ID for itself).
